title: ICLHerd: Herding-Based Data Selection for LLMs with In-Context Learning as a Proxy
abstract: arXiv:2610.27142v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Data selection plays a central role in modern large language model training, as the quality of training data strongly influences downstream performance. A common approach is to curate a development set that encodes the desired skills (e.g., reasoning or multilinguality) and select data that are similar to them. Existing methods compute similarity using cosine distance over either the model's hidden states or gradients. However, we observe that this max-similarity strategy induces a mode-seeking bias: the selected data clusters tightly around the development samples. To address this, we propose ICLHerd, a data selection framework that leverages the von Mises-Fisher kernel to balance mode-seeking with mode-averaging. We further introduce in-context learning as a validation proxy, enabling efficient hyperparameter search over the balance trade-off. translated_title: ICLHerd：基于Herding的大语言模型数据选择方法，以上下文学习作为代理
translated_abstract: 数据选择在现代大语言模型训练中扮演着核心角色，因为训练数据的质量强烈影响下游性能。一种常见的方法是策划一个编码了所需技能（例如推理或多语言能力）的开发集，并选择与这些技能相似的数据。现有方法使用模型隐藏状态或梯度上的余弦距离来计算相似度。然而，我们观察到这种最大相似度策略会引发模式寻求偏差：所选数据紧密聚集在开发样本周围。为了解决这个问题，我们提出了ICLHerd，这是一个数据选择框架，利用von Mises-Fisher核来平衡模式寻求与模式平均。我们进一步引入上下文学习作为验证代理，从而能够在平衡权衡上进行高效的超参数搜索。结果表明，ICLHerd优于现有的大语言模型数据选择算法，凸显了……
tldr: ICLHerd提出了一种基于von Mises-Fisher核的数据选择框架，通过平衡模式寻求与模式平均来克服传统最大相似度方法的聚类偏差，并利用上下文学习作为验证代理实现高效的超参数搜索，在大语言模型训练数据选择上优于现有算法。
